'''Robert Detweiler''' (20 July 1930 &ndash; 8 December 2003) was an American [[Rowing (sport)|competition rower]] and Olympic champion, [[naval officer]], and scientist of [[solid state physics]]. He won a gold medal in the [[Rowing at the 1952 Summer Olympics – Men's eight|men's eight]] at the [[1952 Summer Olympics]], as a member of the American team.<ref name=sports-ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20200418062223/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/de/bob-detweiler-1.html Profile: Bob Detweiler] ''sports.reference.com'' (Retrieved on 10 December 2008)</ref>

After the Olympics, Detweiler became a member of [[the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints]].<ref>''Deseret News Church Almanac'', 2009 edition, p. 326</ref>
